title: Seth Godin's blog — 'Eric Ries has a new book, Incorruptible' (launch-day post)
summary: Seth Godin marks launch day with a post on seths.blog framing Incorruptible as a 'prescription' for what's coming — a map for people seeking coordinated change in a system designed around short-term, selfish and toxic incentives. Godin is also a back-of-book endorser.
blockquote: Eric Ries has a new book, Incorruptible. It’s based on the clear truth that our economic system is filled with incentives that cause well-meaning people (especially bosses) to make short-term, selfish and toxic decisions.
blockquote_source: Seth Godin, 'Predictions, prescriptions and systems change' (seths.blog, May 26, 2026)
